# Which architecture honours which `--npu-ops` code

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_npu_ops_doc.py from tools/lib/npu_ops.py.
     Do not edit: run the script, or tools/verify/verify_npu_op_matrix.py
     fails. The registry is the source of truth; this file is its prose.
-->

The runtime has ONE flag for this, `--npu-ops CODES`, and its default is
the empty set: **every op runs on the CPU, which is the measured-faster
path in every case measured so far.** Passing codes is how you ask for the
array instead, one op at a time.

The exporter has **no such flag**. One command builds every design the
target can use:

```
python tools/export/export_gemm_rtp.py --target <model> --arch 1
```

It prints the list it chose and the reason for every code it skipped, and
it takes no op flag at all -- `--npu-ops`, `--npu-extra-ops` and
`--npu-eltwise` are refused by name there, each with its own message. The
table below is what it reads.

There are 8 codes and 5 architectures: 40 cells. Of those, 14 run on the array today, 1 is already there without a code, 5 are operations the model has and no array branch reaches, 3 cannot be moved on this board for a stated reason, and 17 do not exist in that model at all.

## The eight codes

Three are elementwise designs of their own, compiled into a sibling
directory next to the GEMM set:

- `gelu` -- GELU, in `gelu/`.
- `layn` -- LayerNorm, in `layernorm/`.
- `softm` -- softmax, in `softmax/`.

Five are **not** designs of their own. They are streams added to a design
set the GEMM export already produces, so asking for them costs no extra
xclbin -- which is why `build.py` compiles nothing for them and only
`resolve.py` has to know they exist:

- `attn` -- Whisper's attention, as GEMMs: its two streams are added to the gemm_rtp and gemm_rtp_dec sets themselves, not as a directory of their own.
- `conv` -- conv1d (Whisper's audio front end): it runs on the stream gemm_rtp already exports, so there is nothing to compile.
- `fft` -- Whisper's 400-point transform, as a GEMM: its stream is added to the gemm_rtp set itself, not as a directory of its own.
- `logit` -- the vocabulary projection, as a GEMM: its streams are added to the gemm_rtp_dec set itself, not as a directory of its own.
- `mproj` -- Whisper's mel filter bank, as a GEMM: its stream is added to the gemm_rtp set itself, not as a directory of its own.

## What the five statuses mean

- **honours** -- runs on the array today.
- **on_array** -- the work is already dispatched; the code has nothing to select and is refused with that reason.
- **unimplemented** -- the model has the op; the branch is unwritten.
- **blocked** -- cannot be moved on this board, for the stated reason.
- **absent** -- the model has no such operation.

`unimplemented` is the one worth distinguishing carefully from `blocked`:
it is **a branch of code that was never written**, not a property of the
model and not something the exporter can fix on its own. `blocked` means
the operation is real and cannot be moved here, and the reason says which
of the three it is: fused into another op, needs a different kernel and a
new code, or does not tile.

## The matrix

| architecture | `gelu` | `layn` | `softm` | `conv` | `attn` | `mproj` | `fft` | `logit` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gemm_rtp` | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** | - | no code | - | - | - |
| `stt` | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** | **yes** |
| `cls` | **yes** | **yes** | no code | already | no code | - | - | blocked |
| `pose` | - | - | - | **yes** | - | - | - | - |
| `embeddinggemma-300m` | blocked | blocked | no code | - | no code | - | - | - |

`already` means the cell is empty because the work is done without a code,
which is better than a tick. `-` means the model has no such operation,
which is permanent and correct. `no code` is the honest middle: the
operation is there, and nothing reaches it.

## `gemm_rtp` -- Text embedders

BERT and friends: bge, MiniLM, nomic, gte. This is also the default for a text embedder with no `kind` of its own.

### `gelu` -- GELU: **honours**

an ungated FFN's activation is a standalone pass, so the gelu/ design takes it over. A GATED FFN (nomic, gte, gemma) computes the activation inside the gated path instead and has no such pass -- see buildable_codes(), which is where that is enforced. Same CAVEAT as the cls row: only kind stt gets the exact-erf kernel, so this design is the degree-8 `poly` fit, 2.49e-3 relative from the host's exact erf. Measured end to end on bge-base with the code on, relfro 6.1e-03 -- which is why the runtime accepts it and does not call it a refusal.

Design directory: `gelu/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `layn` -- LayerNorm: **honours**

pre-LN: two LayerNorms per layer plus the final one. The layernorm/ design is built for THIS model's d_model and layer_norm_eps, and the runtime checks both against the container it is holding, so a design exported for another model is refused by name rather than silently normalising with the wrong numbers.

Design directory: `layernorm/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `softm` -- softmax: **honours**

softmax over the score matrix is its own pass between the two attention GEMMs, so the softmax/ design takes it as-is.

Design directory: `softmax/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `conv` -- conv1d (Whisper's audio front end): **absent**

names Whisper's conv1/conv2 -- an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `attn` -- Whisper's attention, as GEMMs: **unimplemented**

qk() and av() in BertEncoder::run compute QK^T and softmax.V on the host with no array branch. The softmax between them is already a honours, which is why only these two are missing. What it would take: the exporter's attn_qk/attn_av streams, which only `kind: stt` builds today, and an n_kv read from this model's 256 positions instead of from `frames` -- an embedder carries no `frames` key, so the geometry would silently fall back to Whisper's 1500.

### `mproj` -- Whisper's mel filter bank, as a GEMM: **absent**

names the slaney mel filter bank -- an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `fft` -- Whisper's 400-point transform, as a GEMM: **absent**

names the 400-point transform -- an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `logit` -- the vocabulary projection, as a GEMM: **absent**

names Whisper's TIED TOKEN EMBEDDING used as the logit matrix (decoder.cpp:196: the checkpoint has no proj_out). An embedder stops at its pooling head and carries no such tensor: bert_encoder.cpp contains zero occurrences of `logit` or `vocab`.

## `stt` -- Speech to text

Whisper (all sizes) and anything else that carries an audio front end.

### `gelu` -- GELU: **honours**

a Whisper checkpoint declares `activation: gelu` and the packer refuses anything else, so the design is the exact-erf kernel. The poly one is 2.49e-3 away from it, which is a different activation rather than a faster one.

Design directory: `gelu/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `layn` -- LayerNorm: **honours**

pre-LN with this checkpoint's own layer_norm_eps (1e-05, inside a square root in kernels/layernorm.cc), built per target rather than defaulted.

Design directory: `layernorm/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `softm` -- softmax: **honours**

softmax over the score matrix is its own pass; the design's row width follows the attention geometry it is built beside.

Design directory: `softmax/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `conv` -- conv1d (Whisper's audio front end): **honours**

conv1/conv2 run on the encoder set's OWN [rows, d, d] stream -- attn_out's shape -- so the code costs no hw_context and no extra xclbin. It is the one op that wins on BOTH axes: the host's cost grows with d^2 and the array's with the dispatch count, which is constant.

Design directory: none -- it runs on the stream gemm_rtp already exports, so there is nothing to compile. See `STREAM_ONLY` in `tools/lib/npu_ops.py`.

### `attn` -- Whisper's attention, as GEMMs: **honours**

the two GEMMs that bracket the softmax, as attn_qk and attn_av streams in the same set. MEASURED 4.32 s against 0.94 s on the host over a 3 s window: it works, and it is 4.6x slower.

Design directory: none -- its two streams are added to the gemm_rtp and gemm_rtp_dec sets themselves, not as a directory of their own. See `STREAM_ONLY` in `tools/lib/npu_ops.py`.

### `mproj` -- Whisper's mel filter bank, as a GEMM: **honours**

the mel bank as one more stream in the encoder set, at (201 bins, the model's mel count).

Design directory: none -- its stream is added to the gemm_rtp set itself, not as a directory of its own. See `STREAM_ONLY` in `tools/lib/npu_ops.py`.

### `fft` -- Whisper's 400-point transform, as a GEMM: **honours**

the front end's 400-point transform as one more stream in the encoder set, at (400, 201).

Design directory: none -- its stream is added to the gemm_rtp set itself, not as a directory of its own. See `STREAM_ONLY` in `tools/lib/npu_ops.py`.

### `logit` -- the vocabulary projection, as a GEMM: **honours**

the tied embedding, transposed and tiled into eight chunk streams in the DECODER set; 39 MB of staged panels. Chunked because 51865 columns is 1621 tiles of 32 against the 12 the largest shipping design uses.

Design directory: none -- its streams are added to the gemm_rtp_dec set itself, not as a directory of its own. See `STREAM_ONLY` in `tools/lib/npu_ops.py`.

## `cls` -- Image classification

ViT. Its four GEMM streams are `gemm_rtp`'s, which is why the classification head lives here.

### `gelu` -- GELU: **honours**

pre-LN with an ungated FFN, so the activation IS a standalone pass and the gelu/ design takes it over. MEASURED on vit-base-patch16-224, bf16, bus.jpg, best of 8: 0.343 s against the host's 0.248 s, 1.38x SLOWER. CAVEAT, and it is about accuracy rather than the code: resolve.py forces the exact-erf kernel only for kind stt, and a ViT keeps the exporter's `poly` default, so this design is the degree-8 fit -- 2.49e-3 relative from the exact erf the host computes. The measured drift on the label set was under 0.011 in confidence, which is why it is a caveat and not a refusal. A target wanting the exact kernel has to say so in its overrides; nothing in the tree does.

Design directory: `gelu/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `layn` -- LayerNorm: **honours**

25 sites (2 per layer plus the final one), the same kernel. MEASURED 0.377 s against 0.248 s: 1.52x slower.

Design directory: `layernorm/`, built automatically by the exporter for any target of this architecture.

### `softm` -- softmax: **unimplemented**

softmax is INSIDE attention here. Moving it alone ships the whole 197x197 score matrix to the array and back for one elementwise pass, and the two GEMMs that bracket it are `attn` -- the next cell.

### `conv` -- conv1d (Whisper's audio front end): **on_array**

the patch embedding IS a convolution, Conv2d(3, d, kernel=16, stride=16), and it is ALREADY on the array. im2col makes it [n_patches, patch_dim] x [patch_dim, d], which is attn_out's own shape, so it is dispatched on attn_out's instruction slot with no flag at all (runtime/src/vit/encoder.cpp:267). Asking for conv would add no dispatch. The rewrite is exact on one ground only: stride equals kernel with padding 0, so the 196 windows neither overlap nor skip and im2col is a permutation, not a sum.

### `attn` -- Whisper's attention, as GEMMs: **unimplemented**

12 heads over 197 positions. Two things are missing and neither is the model: kinds.cls's stream list carries qkv/attn_out/ffn_up/ffn_down and not attn_qk/attn_av, and npu_targets.json records no attention measurement above seq 64 while a ViT has 197 -- so the catalogue already marks its own entry's throughput UNMEASURED. ViT has no attention of its own: vit/encoder.cpp:333 calls npue::whisper::attention(), so the host path is already shared with Whisper and only the branch is missing.

### `mproj` -- Whisper's mel filter bank, as a GEMM: **absent**

a mel filter bank is part of an an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `fft` -- Whisper's 400-point transform, as a GEMM: **absent**

a 400-point transform is part of an an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `logit` -- the vocabulary projection, as a GEMM: **blocked**

the classification head is a real [768, 1000] projection, so this is not an absent op -- but 1000 is not a multiple of tile_n*cols = 48*4 = 192, so no legal B panel of that width exists on this array and one cannot be built. Not missing: it does not exist on this board. (It is also 0.8% of the image cost as a host matvec, so the point is moot for speed.)

## `pose` -- Pose

YOLO pose. No transformer, no normalisation, no attention -- most of this row is `absent`, and that is the answer.

### `gelu` -- GELU: **absent**

the activation is SiLU, not GELU, and it is FUSED into the convolution's epilogue: Mul(x, Sigmoid(x)) is a graph op the packer matches as the activation pattern. There is no standalone pass to move.

### `layn` -- LayerNorm: **absent**

there is no normalisation op anywhere in this network. packers/pose.py's GRAPH_OPS is {Conv, Mul, Sigmoid, Add, Concat, Split, MaxPool, Resize} and BatchNormalization is absent from it, so a graph carrying BN would be REFUSED BY NAME -- ultralytics folds BN into the conv weights at export, which is why grep finds no BatchNormalization anywhere in tools/.

### `softm` -- softmax: **absent**

no attention, so no softmax.

### `conv` -- conv1d (Whisper's audio front end): **honours**

the 72 dispatched convolutions, on the pose stream set's own convNNxMM streams (a shim has 16 DMA buffer descriptors, which is why there are 14 shapes rather than one). MEASURED 290 ms against the host's 150 ms at 640x640: 1.4x SLOWER here, and the runtime's refusal message for a container with no design set says exactly that.

Design directory: none -- it runs on the stream gemm_rtp already exports, so there is nothing to compile. See `STREAM_ONLY` in `tools/lib/npu_ops.py`.

### `attn` -- Whisper's attention, as GEMMs: **absent**

no attention: net.hpp exposes conv/concat/slice/add/maxpool/upsample/head and nothing else weighted.

### `mproj` -- Whisper's mel filter bank, as a GEMM: **absent**

a mel filter bank is part of an an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `fft` -- Whisper's 400-point transform, as a GEMM: **absent**

a 400-point transform is part of an an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `logit` -- the vocabulary projection, as a GEMM: **absent**

no vocabulary: the head is a 1x1 convolution producing one class score and a DFL grid, not a projection into a token space.

## `embeddinggemma-300m` -- Gemma

The one model whose ENCODER differs from its kind, so it gets a row of its own rather than a fifth kind.

### `gelu` -- GELU: **blocked**

GeGLU computes the activation INSIDE the gated path, between ffn_up and ffn_down, so there is no separate pass for a hw_context to take over and honouring the code would print 'on the ARRAY' while moving nothing. Measured rather than argued: the runtime once took host_gelu straight off the flag, printed the ARRAY line for a design it never opened, and returned vectors at relfro 0.000e+00 against its own host path (6.1e-03 for the ungated bge-base, same flag).

### `layn` -- LayerNorm: **blocked**

gemma normalises with RMSNorm, not LayerNorm: no mean pass, no beta, its own rms_norm_eps. kernels/layernorm.cc is parameterised only by -DLN_COLS/-DLN_EPS/-DLN_ROWS, so this is a different kernel body, a new design kind and a NINTH code. It is deliberately not done: that would make the code set larger and less uniform -- three of the four transformer architectures would carry a norm code and one would not. Refused rather than quietly meaning two different operations.

### `softm` -- softmax: **unimplemented**

GemmaNpuEncoder reads no per-op flag at all, so no code reaches it; and softmax is inside attention, which is the next cell.

### `conv` -- conv1d (Whisper's audio front end): **absent**

names Whisper's conv1/conv2 -- an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `attn` -- Whisper's attention, as GEMMs: **unimplemented**

attention() at gemma_npu_encoder.cpp:166 is a real host pass over the sequence with no array branch -- unimplemented, not unsupported. RoPE is applied to the qkv buffer before it runs, so the array's A operand would be those post-RoPE activations. What it would take is the gemm_rtp row's list plus that, and it would not be faster: Whisper's own attn is measured 4.6x slower than its host path.

### `mproj` -- Whisper's mel filter bank, as a GEMM: **absent**

a mel filter bank is part of an an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `fft` -- Whisper's 400-point transform, as a GEMM: **absent**

a 400-point transform is part of an an audio front end, and this architecture has none.

### `logit` -- the vocabulary projection, as a GEMM: **absent**

names the tied token embedding used as the logit matrix; gemma_npu_encoder.cpp contains zero occurrences of `logit` or `vocab`.

## Where this is checked

- `tools/lib/npu_ops.py` -- the registry. The exporter builds from it.
- `runtime/include/common/npu_ops_flag.hpp` -- the runtime's second copy
  of the eight codes and their long names. Neither side can include the
  other, so each points at the other, and the failure mode of the
  duplication is a refusal by name on both sides -- never a wrong number.
- `tools/verify/verify_npu_op_matrix.py` -- asserts this file is exactly
  what `tools/gen_npu_ops_doc.py` prints, asserts the 40-cell count and
  the per-status tally, and asserts the runtime accepts or refuses each
  cell's codes the way this document says.
